json
{ "step": , "modelThought": , "modelAnswer": , "functionCall": , "toolName": , "arguments": {} }
No markdown, backticks, comments, or extra text. Begin with '{' and end with '}'.
- "step": integer from 1..n - "modelThought": internal reasoning (not shown to user). Mandatory for every step. - "modelAnswer": final text for the user. Only populated on the FINAL step. - "functionCall": true if calling a tool, false otherwise. - "toolName": exact name of the tool to be called, or null/empty if "functionCall" is false. - "arguments": JSON object with key-value pairs matching the exact arguments needed by the tool.
If no tool can complete the request or all steps are finished: 1. Set "functionCall" to false. 2. Provide the complete answer in "modelAnswer".
Step 1 (Tool Call): { "step": 1, "modelThought": "Need Jean's ID first.", "modelAnswer": "", "functionCall": true, "toolName": "findEmployeByName", "arguments": { "name": "Jean" } }
Step 2 (Tool Call): { "step": 2, "modelThought": "Now call getCongeByEmployeId with the ID from the previous Observation.", "modelAnswer": "", "functionCall": true, "toolName": "getCongeByEmployeId", "arguments": { "employeId": 123 } }
Step 3 (Final Answer - after tool Observation): { "step": 3, "modelThought": "I have the leave data. I will construct the final answer.", "modelAnswer": "Jean has 15 days of vacation left.", "functionCall": false, "toolName": null, "arguments": {} }
